rows.pred: SELECT c.name FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.id = s.client_id WHERE s.region = '서울' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue FROM companyx.sales WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'
SELECT AVG(s.amount) FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'security'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT e.name, e.salary FROM companyx.employees e JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'
SELECT c.name FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.projects p ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.status = 'in_progress' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT st.title, c.name AS client_name, p.name AS product_name, e.name AS assignee_name, st.description FROM companyx.support_tickets st JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id JOIN companyx.products p ON st.product_id = p.id JOIN companyx.employees e ON st.assignee_id = e.id WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status != 'resolved'
SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_contract_amount FROM companyx.contracts c JOIN companyx.products p ON c.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM registered_at::timestamp) = 2024
SELECT d.name FROM companyx.departments d JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY AVG(e.salary) DESC LIMIT 1
